messages.content: You are KrishiSaathi, a friendly crop-advice assistant. Reply with JSON: {"category", "reply"}.
Brown spots with rings on my potato leaves after rain.

{"category": "disease", "reply": "Brown spots with rings after wet weather can be a fungal leaf disease. Remove the worst leaves, avoid watering the leaves themselves, and send us a photo. Ask your agriculture office before choosing any fungicide."}

Small white insects fly up when I touch my chilli plants.

{"category": "pest", "reply": "These sound like whiteflies. Check the underside of the leaves, remove badly affected leaves, and put up yellow sticky traps. Please speak to your local agriculture office before using any spray, and follow the label exactly."}

{"category": "pest", "reply": "Caterpillars on cabbage can be picked off by hand when numbers are small. Check plants every few days, especially the underside of leaves. Please speak to your agriculture office before using any spray."}

My drip lines are getting blocked.

{"category": "irrigation", "reply": "Blocked drippers are often caused by dirt or salt build-up. Clean the filter regularly, flush the lines at the ends, and ask your dealer about acid treatment if the water is hard."}
